THE
RECEIPTS.

This covers the original UK television series: three series, six episodes each. Films, specials and the US remake are excluded.

Episode titles and original air dates come from TVmaze. The 18 user scores were recorded from IMDb’s episode ratings grid on 28 October 2026. Ratings change over time. Means here are simple averages of the displayed one-decimal scores, not weighted by vote count.

Word counts come from Springfield’s episode transcripts. We lowercased and split text into words, counting exact matches. The transcripts contain occasional spelling errors and unlabelled speakers; our counts are approximate representations of the show’s language, not a verified account of who said what. We display aggregates, not full scripts.

The visual storytelling takes inspiration from Peter O’Connor’s Peep Show project. This is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with the programme or its creators.
